notes: Overall healthy: the shard is genuinely art/craft/yarn supplies from Tegne.no, Panduro, Hobbii and Outland. The real damage is 19 rows that are not hobby items at all (10 canvas wall pictures, 5 KappAhl garments, 2 hair elastics, 1 dining chair, 1 child-safety sticker set), plus a large brand gap — Tegne.no publishes no brand field, so ~100 rows read 'Unspecified' while the name starts with Sakura/Schmincke/Williamsburg/Van Gogh/Talens. Paint lines also sit as dozens of unlinked single-colour rows (30 variant families proposed). Images are missing on roughly half the rows (sampled shops), a crawl-coverage gap rather than a data fault, so it is not reported per row.
